description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet ne rrugen ' Jordan Misja ' kompleksi Gener2 afer me SPAK-un
Ndodhet ne katin e 5 dhe te fundit me orientim Jug-Perendim ka drite gjate gjithe dites.
Siperfaqja e apartamentit eshte 108m2 bruto dhe 98m2neto.
Apartamenti ka te gjitha facilitet e mundshme qe mund te kete Rezidenca markete , Lokale e shume biznsese te tjera.
Ka akses me Bulevardin e ri , me unazen e madhe dhe unazen e vogel , 10 minuta nga Qendra shume dhe afer me zogun e zi .
Apartamenti eshte i mobiluar por do plotesohet dhe ne varesi te kerkesave te klientit .

description_en: The apartment is located on the street "Jordan Misja", the Gener2 complex, close to SPAK. It is located on the 5th and last floor, facing South-West, with light throughout the day. The surface of the apartment is 108m2 gross and 98m2 net. The apartment has all the possible facilities that a market residence, shop and many other businesses can have. There is access to the new Boulevard, the big ring and the small ring, 10 minutes from the center and very close to the black bird. The apartment is furnished, but it will be completed depending on the client's requests. furnished. Legacy136267
